feature: Local register creates user and returns JWT
description: POST /auth/register with valid body { email, password (>=12 chars), name } returns 201 { data: { token, user: { id, email, name } } }. passwordHash must NOT be in response.

feature: Local login returns JWT for valid credentials
description: POST /auth/login with correct email+password returns 200 { data: { token, user: { id, email, name } } }. Wrong credentials returns 401 { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.
GET /auth/me with valid Authorization: Bearer <token> returns 200 { data: { id, email, name } }. No token returns 401.
A JWT signed with exp in the past is rejected with 401. The middleware must verify expiry, not just signature.

feature: Google SSO exchange creates new user (201)
description: POST /auth/sso/exchange with a valid Supabase Google access token for a new email returns 201 { data: { token, user } } and creates a user row with googleId set.

feature: Google SSO exchange links provider to existing email
description: POST /auth/sso/exchange where a local user already exists with that email: returns 200 and updates the user row with googleId (no new row created).

feature: GitHub SSO exchange creates new user (201)
description: POST /auth/sso/exchange with a valid Supabase GitHub access token for a new email returns 201 { data: { token, user } } and creates a user row with githubId set.

feature: GitHub SSO exchange links provider to existing email
description: POST /auth/sso/exchange for GitHub where a local user already exists with that email: returns 200 and updates the user row with githubId.

feature: SSO exchange returns 503 when Supabase not configured
description: When SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY are not set, POST /auth/sso/exchange returns 503 { error: 'SSO not configured' }.
After POST /auth/login succeeds, the user row in DB has lastLoginAt set to a timestamp within the last 5 seconds.
POST /auth/register with password shorter than 12 chars returns 400 with a validation error message.
POST /auth/register with an already-registered email returns 409 { error: 'Email already in use' }.

feature: Audit event recorded on successful login
description: After a successful login, AuditEvent row with eventType='auth.login.success' exists in DB for that userId.
POST /projects with { name, description?, color? } returns 201 { data: { id, name, color, ownerId, createdAt } }. ownerId must equal the authenticated user's id.

feature: List projects returns only caller's projects
description: GET /projects returns 200 { data: [...] } containing only projects owned by the authenticated user. Projects owned by other users must not appear.
GET /projects/:id for a project owned by the caller returns 200 { data: { id, name, color, ownerId, ... } }.

feature: Update project returns 200 with updated fields
description: PATCH /projects/:id with { name: 'New Name' } returns 200 { data: { id, name: 'New Name', ... } }.
DELETE /projects/:id for own project returns 200 { data: { deleted: true } }.
GET /projects/:id for a project owned by user B, when authenticated as user A, returns 404.
PATCH /projects/:id for a project owned by user B, when authenticated as user A, returns 404.
DELETE /projects/:id for a project owned by user B, when authenticated as user A, returns 404.
After DELETE /projects/:id, all Task rows with projectId matching that project are gone from the DB.

feature: Default color applied when color omitted
description: POST /projects with no color field returns 201 with color set to the default value '#3b82f6'.
POST /projects with ownerId: 'attacker-id' in the body still sets ownerId to the authenticated user's id.

feature: Create task under own project returns 201
description: POST /projects/:projectId/tasks with { title, description?, status?, priority?, dueDate? } returns 201 { data: { id, title, status, priority, projectId, ... } }.

feature: List tasks returns only tasks in own project
description: GET /projects/:projectId/tasks returns 200 { data: [...] } with tasks belonging to that project. Cross-project tasks must not appear.
GET /projects/:projectId/tasks?status=TODO returns only tasks with status=TODO. Tasks with status=DONE must not appear.
GET /projects/:projectId/tasks?priority=HIGH returns only tasks with priority=HIGH.
GET /projects/:projectId/tasks?dueWithin=today returns only tasks with dueDate on today's date.
GET /projects/:projectId/tasks?search=foo returns tasks whose title or description contains 'foo' (ILIKE).
By default (includeArchived omitted or false), tasks with archivedAt != null must NOT appear in the list.
GET /projects/:projectId/tasks?includeArchived=true includes tasks with archivedAt set.

feature: Update task returns 200 with updated fields
description: PATCH /tasks/:id with { title: 'Updated' } returns 200 { data: { id, title: 'Updated', ... } }.
DELETE /tasks/:id for a task in own project returns 200 { data: { deleted: true } }.
PATCH /tasks/:id for a task in another user's project returns 404.
POST /projects/:projectId/tasks with status: 'INVALID' returns 400 with a validation error.

feature: Setting dueDate to null clears it
description: PATCH /tasks/:id with { dueDate: null } returns 200 and the task's dueDate is null in the response.

feature: archivedAt set and unset via PATCH
description: PATCH /tasks/:id with { archivedAt: <ISO date> } sets archivedAt. PATCH with { archivedAt: null } clears it.

feature: Bulk status sets all owned tasks
description: POST /tasks/bulk/status with { ids: [...], status: 'DONE' } returns 200 { data: { updated: N } } and all tasks have status=DONE in DB.
POST /tasks/bulk/status including a task owned by another user returns 403 { error: 'Unauthorized', unauthorizedIds: [...] }.

feature: Bulk move moves tasks to target project
description: POST /tasks/bulk/move with { ids: [...], projectId: <targetId> } returns 200 { data: { updated: N } } and tasks now have projectId=targetId.

feature: Bulk move returns 403 with unauthorizedIds on partial ownership
description: POST /tasks/bulk/move including tasks not owned by the caller returns 403 { error: 'Unauthorized', unauthorizedIds: [...] }.

feature: Bulk archive sets archivedAt on all owned tasks
description: POST /tasks/bulk/archive with { ids: [...] } returns 200 { data: { updated: N } } and all tasks have archivedAt set in DB.

feature: Bulk unarchive clears archivedAt on all owned tasks
description: POST /tasks/bulk/unarchive with { ids: [...] } returns 200 { data: { updated: N } } and all tasks have archivedAt=null.
POST /tasks/bulk/delete with { ids: [...] } returns 200 { data: { deleted: N } } and task rows are gone from DB.
POST /tasks/bulk/status with more than 500 ids returns 400 with a validation error.

feature: Bulk archive returns 403 on partial ownership
description: POST /tasks/bulk/archive including tasks from another user returns 403 { error: 'Unauthorized', unauthorizedIds: [...] }.

feature: Bulk delete returns 403 on partial ownership
description: POST /tasks/bulk/delete including tasks from another user returns 403 { error: 'Unauthorized', unauthorizedIds: [...] }.
After POST /projects, an Activity row with action='project.created' and subjectType='project' exists in DB.
After PATCH /projects/:id, an Activity row with action='project.updated' exists in DB for that projectId.
After POST /projects/:projectId/tasks, an Activity row with action='task.created' exists in DB.
After PATCH /tasks/:id, an Activity row with action='task.updated' exists in DB.
After PATCH /tasks/:id with a status change, an Activity row with action='task.status.changed' exists with metadata containing { from, to }.
GET /activity?limit=2 returns 200 { data: [...], nextCursor: <id> }. GET /activity?cursor=<id>&limit=2 returns the next page.

feature: Activity filter by subjectId and subjectType
description: GET /activity?subjectId=<taskId>&subjectType=task returns only activity rows for that task.

feature: 3 default views seeded on local register
description: After POST /auth/register, 3 SavedView rows exist for the new user's id in the DB.

feature: 3 default views seeded on SSO new-user
description: After POST /auth/sso/exchange for a brand-new user, 3 SavedView rows exist for the new user.
POST /views with { name, scope: 'user', filter: { status: 'TODO' } } returns 201 { data: { id, name, scope, filter, ownerId } }.

feature: List saved views returns only caller's views
description: GET /views returns 200 { data: [...] } with only views owned by the caller.
PATCH /views/:id with { name: 'Updated' } returns 200 { data: { id, name: 'Updated', ... } }.
DELETE /views/:id returns 200 { data: { deleted: true } }.
POST /views with { scope: 'project', projectId: <id>, ... } creates a view linked to that project.

feature: dueWithin enum exhaustive — all 4 values accepted
description: POST /views with filter.dueWithin set to each of: today, thisWeek, overdue, doneInLast7Days returns 201. Any other value returns 400.

feature: Project-scoped CSV export returns correct columns
description: GET /export/project/:id returns 200 with Content-Type: text/csv and columns: id,title,status,priority,dueDate,archivedAt,projectId,createdAt.

feature: Cross-project CSV export returns all own tasks
description: GET /export/tasks returns all tasks from all projects owned by the caller in CSV format.

feature: RFC 4180 escaping for commas and quotes in values
description: A task with title containing a comma or double-quote is correctly escaped in CSV (quoted field, internal quotes doubled).
GET /export/project/:id response includes Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=... header.
GET /export/project/:id does NOT include tasks with archivedAt set unless includeArchived=true is passed.

feature: Cross-project export excludes other users' tasks
description: GET /export/tasks only returns tasks from projects owned by the authenticated user. Other users' tasks must not appear.

feature: Create API token returns raw token once
description: POST /api-tokens with { name, scope?, expiresAt? } returns 201 { data: { id, name, prefix, rawToken, ... } }. rawToken is the full token.

feature: List API tokens does not expose raw token
description: GET /api-tokens returns 200 { data: [...] } where each entry has NO tokenHash and NO raw token field.
DELETE /api-tokens/:id returns 200 { data: { revoked: true } } and sets revokedAt in DB.
An API token with expiresAt in the past, used as Bearer token, returns 401.
An API token that has been revoked (revokedAt set), used as Bearer token, returns 401.

feature: API token hashed with HMAC-SHA256 + pepper, not bcrypt
description: After POST /api-tokens, the tokenHash in the ApiToken row starts with 'hmac:' or is a hex string, NOT a bcrypt hash (i.e., does NOT start with '$2b$').

feature: Service-scope token accepted on service endpoints
description: A token with scope='service' can access GET /reminders/due-today and returns 200.

feature: User-scope token rejected on service-only endpoints
description: A token with scope='user' (the default) gets 403 on GET /reminders/due-today.
After POST /auth/register, AuditEvent with eventType='auth.register' exists in DB.
After successful POST /auth/login, AuditEvent with eventType='auth.login.success' and actorId set exists in DB.

feature: auth.login.failure event recorded with no actorId
description: After a failed POST /auth/login, AuditEvent with eventType='auth.login.failure' exists in DB with actorId null.
After POST /api-tokens, AuditEvent with eventType='api-token.created' exists in DB.
After DELETE /api-tokens/:id, AuditEvent with eventType='api-token.revoked' exists in DB.
After POST /projects, AuditEvent with eventType='project.created' exists in DB.
After DELETE /projects/:id, AuditEvent with eventType='project.deleted' exists in DB.
After POST /webhooks, AuditEvent with eventType='webhook.created' exists in DB.
After a 403 bulk op, AuditEvent with eventType='auth.access.denied' exists in DB.
After a successful POST /tasks/bulk/status, AuditEvent with eventType='task.bulk.status' exists in DB.
After POST /views, AuditEvent with eventType='view.created' exists in DB.
After DELETE /webhooks/:id, AuditEvent with eventType='webhook.deleted' exists in DB.
POST /webhooks returns 201 { data: { id, url, events, active, secret, createdAt } }. The secret field contains the raw secret.

feature: List webhooks does not expose secret
description: GET /webhooks returns 200 { data: [...] } where no entry has a 'secret' field.

feature: Rotate secret returns new secret once
description: POST /webhooks/:id/rotate-secret returns 200 { data: { ..., secret: <newSecret> } }. Subsequent GET /webhooks does not include the secret.
POST /webhooks/:id/test returns 200 { data: { dispatched: true } }.
The dispatched POST to the webhook URL includes X-VGX-Signature: sha256=<hmac> header. The HMAC is computed with the endpoint's secret and the raw body.
After PATCH /webhooks/:id with { active: false }, no webhook POST is sent when a task event fires.
A webhook subscribed only to 'task.created' does NOT receive a POST when 'task.updated' fires.

feature: All 7 task event types fire webhooks
description: Webhooks fire for: task.created, task.updated, task.status.changed, task.completed, task.archived, task.unarchived, task.deleted — each triggering the correct event type.
PATCH /tasks/:id responds within 500ms even if the webhook receiver is slow (e.g., 2s delay). Dispatch is non-blocking.

feature: Due-today endpoint returns tasks due today
description: GET /reminders/due-today with a service-scope token returns 200 { data: { grouped: { <userId>: [...tasks] } } } containing tasks due today.
GET /reminders/overdue with a service-scope token returns 200 with tasks whose dueDate is before today and status != DONE.

feature: Reminder endpoints reject user-scope tokens with 403
description: GET /reminders/due-today with a user-scope API token (scope='user') returns 403.
GET /reminders/due-today response has tasks grouped by userId key so n8n can iterate per owner.
GET /search?q=<term> returns 200 { data: { projects: [...], tasks: [...], comments: [...] } } where projects whose name ILIKE-matches the term appear.

feature: Search matches tasks by title or description
description: GET /search?q=<term> returns tasks whose title or description contains the term (ILIKE).

feature: Search results isolated to caller's data
description: GET /search?q=<term> returns only projects, tasks, and comments owned by or accessible to the authenticated user. Other users' data must not appear.
GET /search?q=a (1 char) returns 400 with a validation error about minimum query length.
GET /search?q=<200+ chars> returns 400 with a validation error about maximum query length.

feature: Three columns rendered for TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE
description: The project detail page in kanban view renders exactly 3 columns labelled TODO, In Progress, and Done. Each column heading is visible on the page.

feature: Task card appears in correct column based on status
description: A task created with status=TODO appears in the TODO column. A task with status=DONE appears in the DONE column. Tasks do not appear in the wrong column.

feature: Drag task to new column fires PATCH and moves card
description: Dragging a TODO task card into the IN_PROGRESS column calls PATCH /tasks/:id with { status: 'IN_PROGRESS' } and the card appears in the IN_PROGRESS column after the drop.

feature: Column task count badge updates after drag
description: After dragging a task from TODO to DONE, the numeric badge on the TODO column decrements by 1 and the DONE column badge increments by 1.

feature: Drop on same column is a no-op
description: Dragging a task and dropping it back into its own column does not call PATCH /tasks/:id and the task count remains unchanged.

feature: Dark/light mode toggle cycles and persists
description: Clicking the theme toggle on the UI cycles through modes. After a page reload, the selected theme is preserved (stored in localStorage key vgxt-dark).

feature: Sidebar shows 3 default views for new users
description: After registering a new account and logging in, the sidebar displays exactly 3 saved view items (the seeded defaults).

feature: AuthCallback page parses token from URL fragment
description: Navigating to /auth/callback#access_token=<supabase_token> triggers the SSO exchange flow, calls POST /auth/sso/exchange, and stores the JWT in localStorage.

feature: 401 response clears localStorage and redirects to /login
description: If any API call returns 401, the frontend removes the auth token from localStorage and navigates to /login.

feature: SSO buttons present on login page
description: The /login page shows buttons or links that initiate Google and GitHub OAuth flows via the Supabase redirect URL.

feature: CSV export button present on project view
description: The project detail page has an Export CSV button that downloads the project's tasks as a CSV file.
Navigating to /settings/tokens (or equivalent) renders the API token management UI.
Navigating to /settings/webhooks (or equivalent) renders the webhook management UI.

feature: Bulk action bar appears on task selection
description: Checking a task checkbox reveals a bulk action bar at the bottom or top of the list.
Pressing Cmd+K (or Ctrl+K) on any page opens the global search panel.
The app header/sidebar contains an element that loads /vgx-light.webp or /vgx-dark.webp depending on mode.
Primary action buttons (e.g., 'Create Project', 'Save') have a computed background that matches the VGX gradient (purple to pink), not a flat colour.
The page's computed font-family for heading elements includes 'Montserrat' and for body text includes 'Ubuntu'.

feature: Valid text returns structured parsed task
description: POST /tasks/parse with { text: 'Review ICA report tomorrow, high priority' } returns 200 { data: { title: string, dueDate: 'YYYY-MM-DD' | null, priority: 'HIGH' | null, description: string | null } }. title must be a non-empty string.
When GROQ_API_KEY is not set in the environment, POST /tasks/parse returns 503 { error: 'AI parsing not configured' }. This is skipped if the key is present in the test environment.
POST /tasks/parse with text longer than 500 characters returns 400 { error: 'text is required (max 500 chars)' }.

feature: Dark mode logo swap works correctly
description: When dark mode is active, the logo src switches to /vgx-dark.webp. In light mode it uses /vgx-light.webp.

feature: AI smart input pre-fills title, priority, and due date
description: Open create task modal, type 'Fix login bug by Friday high priority' into the smart input field, wait 1 second for AI parse, then verify: title field is pre-filled with a non-empty value, priority is set to HIGH, and a due date has been populated. Depends on Groq API availability.

feature: Keyboard shortcut N opens create task modal
description: On a project page (not inside an input), pressing the N key opens the create task modal. The modal must become visible within 1 second.

feature: Drag task between Kanban columns updates status
description: Create a TODO task, then drag its card from the TODO column to the IN_PROGRESS column using dragAndDrop. After the drop the task card should appear in the IN_PROGRESS column and no longer in TODO.

feature: Kanban column Add task button opens modal with correct default status
description: Clicking the 'Add task' button at the bottom of a Kanban column opens the create task modal. The status field in the modal should default to the column's status (e.g., IN_PROGRESS when clicking the In Progress column's button).

feature: Task detail modal loads title, status, and priority
description: Clicking a task card on the project page opens a task detail modal. The modal must display the task's title, status, and priority visibly within 3 seconds.
